en: A color postcard view of the historic center of Strasbourg with rows of steep-roofed traditional houses in the foreground and the tall Gothic tower and façade of Strasbourg Cathedral rising prominently in the background. The sky is bright blue with light clouds, and a white decorative border frames the image. The words "Alsace" appear at the top and "Strasbourg" at the bottom in a cursive script.
